description: Parameter version of a run after an optional complexity-weights override.
signature: def effective_parameters_version(base_version: str, defaults: Mapping[str, float], effective_weights: Mapping[str, float]) -> str
docstring: Return base_version unchanged when the weights equal the defaults, otherwise a 12-character sha256 of base_version and the weights rounded to 12 places (sorted keys), so a run with custom weights never shares a version with a default run.
preconditions: effective_weights has the same keys as defaults
